The derived record's conventions block has calling_convention null with confidence UNKNOWN and the ambiguity 'receiver_undetermined', because the machine ABI inference read ECX without ever dereferencing it (obs-0002 MOV ESI,ECX is a read; there is no memory operand through ECX or ESI in the whole body). The machine-derived receiver record names no receiver register, so the grounded arms cannot run; the register-agnostic absence arm is also excluded, because _any_field_access() finds the body's one bracketed operand, [ESP + 0x8] in the TEST, and a body that reaches a memory operand of any kind is out of that arm by construction. per_check_reasons.RETURN SEMANTICS: EXPECTED WARN, and this one is partly a naming consequence that was considered and declined. The check is a string comparison between the source's declared return type and the record's abi.return_type, with spaces stripped and nothing else. The record's string is 'pointer to the receiver', which no C identifier equals; it can only be made to agree by spelling the alias as the run-on 'pointertothereceiver'. That spelling was built, verified to turn the check green, and reverted, because degrading the type name to satisfy a string comparison is exactly the kind of metric-chasing this package should not do, and because a check that every honest identifier fails by construction is a limitation of the check. The alias is therefore pointer_to_the_receiver -- the record's own phrase with the spaces turned into underscores, aliasing void* -- and the WARN is accepted. Note what the WARN does NOT mean: the reconstruction follows the listing's EAX write, not the void prototype, and the alias target is the only C type the record's description licenses.

On the machine the distinction is real and load-bearing -- ECX is caller-saved under __thiscall and 0x0067e2b0 makes two calls (0x0067e2e1, 0x0067e2ed), so a body that re-read ECX after them would be wrong. The reconstruction keeps the copy (esi_receiver is bound at 0x0067e6b1 and is the value used at both 0x0067e6bf and 0x0067e6c8), which is the faithful shape, and the test's closest observable proxy is the scribble check, which this mutant also passes because the pointer value is unchanged. m19, hoist the gate-word read above the first transfer. PROVEN behaviourally indistinguishable, and declared in the test file header: the machine reads the word from its own stack slot AFTER the first callee has run (0x0067e6b8, with only the PUSH ESI outstanding), but a C parameter is a by-value copy with no address a callee can reach, so no C reconstruction can distinguish the two orders. m20, introduce an extra unused copy of the same pointer. This is a literal no-op, not a semantic change, so surviving is the correct outcome and it is listed only for completeness.
